staleRule: STALE is never stored: it is the status view of a stored ACTIVE record whose lease is dead (spine/protection.cjs:629-640). view = ACTIVE if phase=ACTIVE and leaseLive, STALE if phase=ACTIVE and not leaseLive, else the stored phase.

stateFields.guarded: the set of tools a live proxy actually intercepts; in this table always the token 'declared' or 'empty'
